decision: CLOSE prior/feasibility screen; no consequential main claim or independent review earned
reference_type: Elementary sampling variance and cohort cost; not a new theorem or experiment

scale_example.training_opportunities_cost: n * sum over endpoints and teachers of T[j,teacher], plus one terminal response per learner
scale_example.nonreactivity_scope: No earlier probe-induced changes for the fixed target first response; later acquisition is not measured in that same cohort
scale_example.precision_scope: Sampling SE under independent Bernoulli responses; not power, a guaranteed interval, latent competence precision, or a recommended human/animal sample size

alternatives.terminal_only: Already supplies the narrow common first-response population endpoint without requiring nonlearning post-response dynamics
alternatives.matched_terminal_cohorts: Separate cohorts at earlier endpoints estimate a population trajectory, priced in independent learners and repeated acquisition, without recovering individual trajectories
alternatives.repeated_full_feedback: Supported by the pinned update law as a changed training protocol; not an unchanged acquisition measurement
alternatives.repeated_without_feedback: The pinned RNN has no separate feedback-withheld condition; zero aliases negative feedback
alternatives.skip_update_or_zero_choice: Skipping is not earned by the learning hypothesis; zero choice encodes omission, inconsistent with a measured left/right response
alternatives.extra_training_control: Additional versus substituted probe opportunities, feedback, session flags and protocol timing must be separated before attributing a change to measurement

unearned: No material 1pp/5pp disturbance threshold is certified
No repeated-probe schedule or novel estimator tested
No general impossibility or exhaustive novelty conclusion
No main experiment, claim freeze, or review
